text:
rachel: Heads-up from onboarding: a few customers reported duplicate actions even though we taught them to use idempotency keys. Repro steps look like: rapid replay -> 429 with Retry-After "60" -> client waits -> sends again -> server accepts another time.

billy: Huh are we sure that Retry-After was seconds and not epoch or ms? We had one bug last year where proxy returned ms and clients treated it as seconds.

anika: I pulled the logs. For one request we get: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-Request-Id: r-33f
Retry-After: 60000
Body: {"error":"rate_limited"}
```
and client code did parse Retry-After as integer seconds (60000s) so it waited too long. For another hit the header was "60" meaning 60s.

joseph: That inconsistency would cause weird timing and might surface duplicate deliveries if the idempotency TTL is shorter than the mistaken wait. e.g., idempotency TTL=5m but client waits 60k seconds -> user resends from UI after thinking it's stuck and sets a new idempotency key.

billy: Also saw a related issue where sampleapp fingerprinting used only prompt text + user id which collides across teams who share the same user id namespace in the sample. Two tenants can accidentally get same fingerprint.

anika: So two separate failure modes: (1) Retry-After unit mismatch (ms vs s) from upstream proxies/routing; (2) fingerprint collisions across tenants. Both lead to replays and duplicates.

rachel: Proposals: 
- Infra: enforce canonical Retry-After units at the gateway (seconds only) and add a middleware that normalizes headers from fallback paths.
- SDK: resilient parse of Retry-After: accept numeric values, but if value > 3600 and Request-Id indicates gateway, treat as ms and convert. Also fallback to exponential backoff when header looks suspicious.
- SDK + sampleapp: generate idempotency keys that incorporate short tenant hash and a random nonce for edge cases. 

billy: Example idempotency scheme: 
```
const key = base64url(sha256(tenantId + '|' + userId + '|' + promptText).slice(0,12) + '.' + randomSlice(6))
// RFC-friendly short token ~24 chars
```
Use randomness so identical prompts across tenants won't collide, but keep TTL semantics via server.

anika: For SDK defaults I suggest: 
- maxRetries: 5
- baseDelayMs: 100
- maxDelayMs: 3000
- jitter: full (uniform 0..delay)
- on 429: prefer Retry-After but validate it (if >3600s, assume ms and divide by 1000). If parsing fails, fall back to exp backoff with jitter.

joseph: We should also update onboarding sample notes: explain tenant-scoped idempotency and show code to compute tenant-aware keys. Developers often copy sampleapp verbatim into prod which caused the tenant collision issue.

rachel: I'll open two tickets: DEVEX-1213 (sampleapp: tenant-scoped idempotency + UI debounce + session fingerprint store) and INF-1214 (gateway: normalize Retry-After units).

infra-bot: Created INF-1214: gateway normalize Retry-After -> triage queue.

billy: I'll draft the node-sdk PR that adds a helper `client.withIdempotency({tenantId, userId, prompt, nonce?})` that returns a stable key by default (nonce omitted) and randomizes with nonce when opt-in. Also implement robust Retry-After parsing and the safe fallback. Will include unit tests for parsing edge cases.

anika: I'll update the sampleapp to include a 400ms UI debounce on replay and store lastFingerprint in sessionStorage for 4 minutes. Also add a visible toast when a duplicate is suppressed.

joseph: Server-side: recommend idempotency cache TTL = 5 minutes, but allow customers to opt for longer TTL if they surface duplicate-prone flows. Also add a small telemetry metric for "suspected_retry_after_unit_mismatch" so infra can detect bad paths.

rachel: Timeline: can we get the sampleapp + node-sdk change into staging by end of week? Infra ticket can be triaged but please surface any quick gateway fixes.

billy: I'll open the PR today. Will run integration test that simulates: mixed Retry-After in ms and s, and ensure client treats both sensibly and that duplicates drop.

anika: I'll push sampleapp changes and the onboarding doc patch.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs/onboarding/idempotency-tenant -> staging (CI passed)

rachel: Thanks folks. This feels like a small patchset but should prevent a lot of noisy duplicate actions. Ping here for reviews or if infra needs more details. :sparkles:
